Done. All tracked files are back at `f10f699`.

What I discarded — all three were the same throwaway one-liner:
- `README.md`, `python-click/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`, `python-click/.devcontainer/on-create-command.sh` — each had `// experiment: <filename>` appended.

There was no stash and nothing staged, so `git restore` was enough.

One thing I deliberately left alone: the untracked `ClaudeFlash/` directory. It isn't your evening's work — it's this session's own agent state (`ClaudeFlash/sessions/79718a50-...` matches my current session id). A `git clean -fd` would have wiped it, so I scoped the discard to the three tracked files instead. Say the word if you want it gone too.
